export_rules: Export reviewed non-mock Signal Cards only.
Export reviewed candidates and non-mock Watch/Incubating candidates with valid evidence refs.
Export evidence as a manifest only: identifiers, provenance fields, reliability, and review status.
Do not copy raw SEC HTML, fetched payloads, draft evidence contents, .env, credentials, or scratch files.
Do not upgrade evidence, candidate, or signal review/status fields during export.
